reviews.text:
Chris and the staff were amazing. I was totally stressed and worried for my cat, Rambo. They explained the full process and procedure and explained the results of their investigations fully. As well as aftercare.
Totally understand why the price is what it is. The only thing missing would have been a follow up from them just to see how things were with Rambo after his procedure. All in all, would recommend and seriously consider using them as regular vets if Rambo wasn't stressed out during car journeys

Eight years ago I had a serious accident and was in a very dark place. A wee black french bulldog of 8 months old came along and saved my life.  On Tuesday of last week at nine years old, she became very unwell, we took her to our Vet and they tried to get her into the animal hospital, they were full.  Crum Pets said they would take her.  We rushed her there and Dr Nick examined her and scanned her and explained she needed surgery straight away, she had a mass on her spleen and they both had to be removed.  Dr Nick took her to surgery, we waited for nearly 4 hours for the call that told us she came through it and with no complications.  He had saved her life.  There are no words to say how grateful we are.  She is home recovering and doing well.  If it wasn't for Dr Nick and all at Crum Pets we could have lost her.  You are angels in scrubs!
Good friendly service.

I visited recently with my Maltese,Alfie. Alfie has developed a heart murmur and we came to have this checked with an echocardiogram. My first impression of the clinic was it looked very welcoming with displayed cards from owners, nicely spaced out seating area with music and it smelled & looked very clean which actually made me feel more at ease as a new customer. Upon appointment , I was greeted  professionally and kindly. I appreciated that Alf's condition was explained thouroughly but also in simple terms for me to understand for example showing me a structure of the heart so I could see the explanation for myself.  Reception were professional and diligent - organising and processing insurance forms very quickly for me and clear communication on Alf's collection time. Paperwork for Alfie's diagnosis was printed for me to take home and read aswell as explained in person which was helpful. I couldn't fault CrumPets for what was a really emotional day for me as an owner and I would definatly recommend and return.

Chris Parratt is a fantastic Veterinary Specialist.

He was very thorough with testing our Dog, who was very unwell, and Chris easily found the main problem.

His Staff too couldn't be any nicer.

This is what you exactly want, when your pet is very unwell.

I'd recommend CrumPets Veterinary Support very strongly.

Chris, even on the day that the results came back from the Lab, of a small lump in our Dog's stomach (very worrying for us), called us immediately, even though he was very busy, to tell us that it was nothing to worry about.

What a great service.

My dog is now thriving again after five days of treatment.

Thank you Chris and Staff, tremendous service.

Fantastic care for our chihuahua Piccola here last week in for a heart scan. Chris and all his team are really helpful and put our minds at rest. Fees are fair with help for insurance claim was provided. Despite living in Inverness we will continue to come to Crumpets for specialist care for our pet .

CrumPets Vet Clinic provided amazing support during an extremely tough time with my pet cat Charlie. The Vet and Staff were incredibly understanding and caring. So grateful for their compassion!Definitely recommend with all my heart. P x

My friend’s dog was referred here by their regular vet for further investigations, including a scan and scope. I came along for moral support.

From the moment we arrived, the whole practice felt warm, welcoming and friendly. It doesn’t have that cold, sterile feeling some veterinary clinics can have, which immediately helped put us at ease.

Sadly, my friend received some very difficult news about her dog. The vet who saw us could not have been more kind or compassionate. He explained everything clearly, talked us through the condition and the options available, and gave us the time and space to process what we were being told. At no point did we feel rushed.

The reception staff were also wonderful — incredibly kind, supportive and understanding during what was a very emotional appointment.

Thank you to everyone at the practice for treating both my friend and her dog with such care, dignity and compassion during such a hard moment.
Amazing support for my cat got him home today reassured me and they took care of the insurance forms already thank you so much ❤️❤️❤️ highly recommend

I took my cat, Pudding, to find out his diagnosis. The vet was friendly but very professional. He explained all the examination options we had and took his time to go through the details while also reassuring me. I knew my cat was in good hands. Unfortunately, the diagnosis was devastating; however, the doctor showed great sympathy, which helped me accept it. The whole place was very client-friendly.

I had my wee dog to crum pets for a heart scan and I can honestly say they
Looked after my wee dog so we'll they even let my other wee dog stay with her for support
So professional and caring they went into great detail explaining the severity off her condition and moving forward with a treatment plan a five star experience from a five star team thank you crum pet 😀

I can't even begin to describe how grateful I am to Chris, Max, and the rest of the team at Crumpets/Emergency Vets Glasgow.

Our cat was unwell, and the team looked after her swiftly and with so much care; they made what should have been a very stressful situation much more manageable.

The aftercare was also second to none. Everything was explained clearly, and we were given a full rundown of the instructions to take home—again, incredibly easy to understand.

When we ran out of medicine that our own vets couldn't source in time, Crumpets provided it within a few hours without any issue.

Every so often, you receive customer service that goes truly above and beyond, and you struggle to put into words how grateful you are—especially when the team makes it look so effortless.

Thanks so much to every member of the team with every fiber of my being!

I was referred to Chris by my local vets due to my chihuahua having a heart murmur. I can honestly say that I couldn’t have hand picked a better place than CrumPets. From the reception team who made me feel at ease from the first telephone call to our consultation and scan with Chris, Everyone who works in CrumPets is warm welcoming and supportive given the serious nature of why we were there. My dog is in the best hands moving forward and I can’t thank them enough for putting me at ease and supporting us through it all with a plan in place for future follow ups. Thank you
Very impressed with the service we received three years ago when my Labrador was one year old. The heart scan, diagnosis and treatment has let her enjoy a life she wouldn’t otherwise have had.

We came to see Chris and the team with our sons cat the team were fantastic unfortunately we didn’t get good news the compassion shown by Chris and the team was amazing. My son is on the spectrum so Chris went out of his way to write him a note explaining everything to him in a way that he would understand and assuring him he could see him much our cat was loved by him thank you so much

These people saved my boys life.
Twice he went in for a Cardial effusian drain with the understanding it could be a sign of deeper trouble or a random on set.
2nd time was the charm and while it cost us an arm and a leg, I get to see Zippo every day.

Our wee boy was referred to a specialist vet due to a suspected heart murmur and we are so glad we picked CrumPets Vet. The team was phenomenal, they explained everything to us and answered all our questions. They were also very quick to process all paperwork which was very helpful too. Happy to say he was ok and he is just a very nervous boy. I contacted them almost 18 months after the referral to query if they could provide a copy of the report as we needed it for new insurance purposes and Gemma got back to me in less than 10 minutes. I do hope they expand to a regular + specialist vet premises because they are fantastic.
Always friendly and super professional. Always put us at ease and give a thorough vet service
Very caring staff and great facilities. I'm very grateful for the compassion and insights.
Fantastic staff showed care and understanding to my pet and myself , the best care I’ve seen in a long time
Wonderful team, very thorough and compassionate. I felt like our little cat was in good hands and although the outcome wasn’t what we hoped for, I know that Chris and the team did all they could.

I cannot speak more highly of this vet. My OES was seriously ill and this practice saved him and for that I can't thank them enough. The after care was fantastic as well. Boris wouldn't be here if it wasn't for these hugely talented people.

I can’t thank Chris, Gemma, Lee-Ann and the team enough.
Rosie needed surgery to remove a malignant splenic mass which was causing her great discomfort and rapidly becoming worse.  Chris explained everything in detail, how it was affecting her and how it could be dealt with.  Rosie underwent surgery to remove her spleen.  Great care is needed in all operations but there was an added complication with Rosie having age-related heart disease.  Chris reassured me that he will have every aspect of Rosie’s condition covered and he is highly experienced when operating under these circumstances.
The phone call from Chris later that day to say that Rosie had come through her op well and was showing positive signs was a huge relief.  The phone call the next day saying she got through the night without issue was also a huge relief.  I picked her up that day and couldn’t believe how well she looked.  Walking about and looking as if she didn’t have a care in the world.  Lucky her!
Rosie is home, eating and drinking and is making great progress in her recovery.  To say I’m relieved would be an understatement.  I’m sure Rosie is too!
I would give everyone and everything at Crumpets 10/10 for how they engaged with me and Rosie and how they take their time to explain everything and ensure that I knew exactly was going to be done.  They are all fantastic, friendly, reassuring, welcoming…. need I go on?!
I would highly recommend Chris and the team at Crumpets and Rosie and I couldn’t be more grateful.
Thank you ❤️

Could not recommend them enough. Their staff are second to none. Chris was amazing. Sadly our beautiful girl could not be saved but their professionalism and compassion made the worst day of our lives a little easier. Shout out to Gemma who was so understanding as I cried in their waiting area as I picked up my darlings ashes. She is a credit to CrumPets. Her friends and family as well as CrumPets should be proud!

Was there 1 year ago with Belle our 8 year old cat. They removed a tumour which had grown behind her nose.
We were told she possibly had 6 weeks of life left as it was a very aggressive type of cancer.
We still have her nearly a year later, she sneezes a lot & is on steroids but is still a happy if somewhat tired cat. Still purrs & plays.
I'm sure it was down to the vets care and experience of the tumour removal that we still have her for how ever long she has left.
Such a wonderful place 🖤 The staff are all incredible and so friendly - they really put wee Gloria and I at such ease. Thank you all so much for looking after us and giving us such good news 🙏🏼🖤 …
Couldn't have asked for nicer vet and staff, especially during a very difficult time. They treated our little Dumpling like a princess. Amazing service. Thank you
Good service. Felt my dog was in very safe hands and results information very clear

I was referred here by my vet for a scan for my dog costing £595,l had questions so called them at 9am today and was told as the referral was over the wknd they would have to find it and someone would call me back,fast forward to 230pm and lm still waiting so l called them,l was then told they wanted to do 5 or so tests at a cost of £2300,l was told that l would receive results of the biopsy that day when l collected my dog,l queried price and was then told the scan etc would be £945,l asked to check with my partner and when l called back to book my dog in l was told l wouldnt be given results on that day,so basically pay the top end and you'll get results dont pay it and you wont,how cruel and upsetting is this,l was then told to call and discuss it with my vet which l did,my vet confirmed that the referral was for a scan only at £595,why were they doing bloods and xrays when they would be done on the day of my dogs operation,it just proves that crumpets dont care about upsetting owners as they did to me today or about my dog the only thing they care about is money,if l couldve given them zero l wouldve,lm disgusted with them,they will not be anywhere near my dog

A big thank you from our cat Honey to Chris and his team for checking her heart today and giving us the good news.

We were extremely worried after her brother sadly passed away from sudden heart failure. Chris was extremely thorough and clear in his explanations. I really appreciated all the imagery and all additional tests he did to give us peace of mind.
If you’re ever in doubt, please go and book a scan with CrumPets to give your pet the best possible care. Extremely professional and trustworthy service.
Thank you again ❤️

I cannot thank Chris and his team enough for their hard work and care. Chris performs annual heart scans on my cat Mew and always gives me such detailed updates on her condition and helps keep me calm when receiving difficult news. My other …
Can’t recommend enough, was amazing with my dog and made us all feel at ease

Very helpful
Chris great thank you
Also Gemma got pet insurance sorted

5 stars is never enough for chris, Gemma and the team. The care and support they have gave me have been excellent 👌 my boy was up a few times. Chris was just the best. Made me feel so at ease knowing that chase was being cared for. Sadly we lost my boy due to complications a short time ago. I will be forever grateful for everything 🙏 🌈❣️ …

Amazing standard of care for my chihuahua Mitzi, very supportive and answered any questions that we had. I can’t thank Crumpets anymore for their fantastic service and the level of knowledge they have is brilliant. Thanks again for all your help and definitely recommend Crumpets! 🐶😁👍🏻 …
